parameters.name: recordID
parameters.description: ID of the dynamic DNS record, as the list shows it

name.description: The record name, such as `home.example.com`; `*.example.com` only where the provider allows wildcards. A name that exists answers 400

dns_credential_id.description: ID of the DNS credential to write the record with; its provider must have an updater

provider.description: The updater provider; it defaults from the credential and must match it when given

zone.description: The zone, used only when none of the credential's domains covers the name; it must cover the name

kind.description: `address` (the default): A and AAAA records that follow the public IP; `alias`: a CNAME to `target`

target.description: The CNAME target of an alias (required for one); an address record takes none. It cannot be the record's own name

ip_version.description: For an address record: `ipv4` (the default), `ipv6` or `both`; an alias takes none

ipv6_suffix.description: An IPv6 interface id such as `::1` that replaces the last 64 bits of the detected address; only with `ipv6` or `both`, and not for an alias

ttl.description: The TTL in seconds; null keeps the provider's default or the record's current TTL

enabled.description: Whether NPMpro keeps the record up to date (the default is true)

description:
Changes a record; only the fields sent change. A changed name, credential or zone clears what NPMpro learned about the record and sets it pending; turning it off sets it disabled. A value the record already has is never refused again on a save that keeps it.

Needs: Certificates manage
